findings: Current Wyoming Legislature Title 30 W.S. 30-5-305(b) was read directly on 2026-09-26. The article preserves its payment-to-interest-owner trigger and the stub, attachment, or otherwise regular-monthly placement alternative.

The article's eleven table rows follow statutory items (i) through (xi) in order, including property or well identifier, sales month and year, volume/unit, unit price, production taxes, itemized other deductions or adjustments, net total-sales value, owner decimal, owner gross and net shares, and an information address.
The certified-mail clause is presented only as context to item (xi), without turning it into a demand-letter or remedy instruction. Section 30-5-305(a) is confined to a division-order/lease boundary.

Current Wyoming Office of State Lands and Investments Trust Land Management page describes royalty compliance for minerals removed from state lands. The article uses that source only to distinguish a state-land program from a private payor contact, and does not assert the agency reviewed any owner's statement.

No payor form, actual owner decimal, deduction validity, title, amount owed, reporting violation, demand remedy, or exact-query demand is claimed. Material propositions have nearby primary-source citations.
